description: Fix critical bugs: database migration causing 404 errors, layout proportions, and scroll synchronization issues

userStories.title: Fix database migration for chapter_href column
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to fix the database migration that fails silently due to SQLite not supporting ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS syntax, causing chunk API to return 404 errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace non-standard SQL with SQLite-compatible column existence check using pragma_table_info
Add chapter_href column only if it doesn't already exist
Migration runs successfully on new databases
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Handle existing database with missing column
userStories.description: As a user with existing books and data, I want the application to automatically detect and fix the missing chapter_href column without losing my existing books and concept graphs.
acceptanceCriteria: Application detects missing column on startup
Automatically adds column if missing (backward compatible)
Existing data remains intact
No manual database reset required
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Optimize three-column layout proportions
userStories.description: As a user, I want the ConceptGraph to have more space so I can better visualize the concept relationships, while the PDF/EPUB reader and detail panel take appropriate amounts of space.
acceptanceCriteria: Adjust layout ratios: Left 40% / Center 50% / Right 280px (was 320px)
When right panel is hidden, center panel expands appropriately
All panels remain usable and content doesn't overflow
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Fix page-level scroll synchronization
userStories.description: As a user, I want to scroll the PDF/EPUB reader independently without the ConceptGraph panel following the scroll, so I can focus on reading while keeping the graph view stable.
acceptanceCriteria: Each panel has its own scroll container with overflow-auto
Scrolling in left panel doesn't affect center/right panels
No page-level scrollbars appear (only panel-level scrollbars)
Header and book title bar remain fixed during panel scrolling
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
